factual_claims.claim: AB KN Energies reported improved financial performance for the nine months ended 30 September 2025, driven by full LNG terminal operations, higher regasification volumes, and positive capacity pricing, despite elevated costs and regulatory adjustments.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 13 (Revenue from contracts with customers) states revenue increased due to LNG terminal returning to full service after dry-dock closure in 2024, higher regasification volumes, and client capacity booking bonuses. Note 13(3) details reduction in security supplement income due to regulatory adjustments.

candidate_sentences.text: AB KN Energies reported improved financial performance for the nine months ended 30 September 2025, driven by full LNG terminal operations, higher regasification volumes, and positive capacity pricing, despite elevated costs and regulatory adjustments.

factual_claims.claim: The primary catalysts for revenue growth included the LNG terminal returning to full commercial service in 2025 after a one-and-a-half-month dry dock closure in late 2024, alongside higher regasification volumes and client capacity booking bonuses.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 13(1) explicitly states: 'Revenue from LNG services during the nine months of 2025 is higher... due to: (i) the terminal being out of operation for one and a half months in 2024... (ii) higher LNG regasification volumes and (iii) bonuses paid by LNGT clients for booked capacity.'

candidate_sentences.text: The primary catalysts for revenue growth included the LNG terminal returning to full commercial service in 2025 after a one-and-a-half-month dry dock closure in late 2024, alongside higher regasification volumes and client capacity booking bonuses.

factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 13(3) states: 'The decrease in revenue was affected by the reduction of LNG security supplement income in 2025 due to proportionally recognised repayment of the excess returns (surplus income) from regulated activities during the period 2022-2023.'
